mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate reaches or exceeds 9.0%, it signals a severe labor market downturn that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE >= 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE >= 9.0%) and weak consumer spending (RSAFS < 380000) indicates a deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE >= 9.0% and RSAFS < 380000.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, characterized by CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation exceeding 2.5% and rising FEDFUNDS, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS rising).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500.0 thousand units, it indicates a contraction in the residential sector, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized quarterly growth rate of real GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 1.5%, it indicates strong economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of periods where GDPC1 annualized growth rate > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls exceeding 200,000 jobs (PAYEMS monthly change > 200) signals a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 40% of periods where PAYEMS monthly change > 200.
